System states

/app/system/:state
Roles: guest, student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: core

Provide consistent full-page recovery for forbidden access, missing destinations, expired sessions and maintenance. Inline task errors remain on their task when recovery is possible there.

Permissions
  • Error status never reveals another person's course existence.
  • A return URL cannot bypass normal identity and course guards.
  • TA access expiry cannot be recovered by selecting instructor context.
Responsive
  • Full-width card on small screens; reference codes wrap.
  • Recovery actions fit at 400% zoom without horizontal page scrolling.
Accessibility
  • Single h1 and page-specific document title; focus error heading on navigation.
  • Use text for state and action; no decorative animation required to understand recovery.
Data
  • State reason enum, safe context, last acknowledged operation and optional redacted reference.
  • Maintenance facts supplied by fixture; unknown ETA remains unknown.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • A guessed private submission URL exposes no learner name in a 403/404 view.
  • Expired-session recovery preserves the destination but rechecks access.
  • Maintenance Retry cannot claim coursework success or repeatedly auto-refresh a form.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
